panels.title: Okresy (klik w okres: wybór okresu i jego zakresu czasu)

targets.queryText:
SELECT label AS okres, CASE time WHEN 'real' THEN 'rzeczywisty' WHEN 'estimated' THEN 'szacowany ±' || printf('%g', time_uncertainty_h) || ' h' ELSE 'zegar urządzenia' END AS czas,
  start AS od, "end" AS do, printf('%.1f h', ("end" - start) / 3600.0) AS długość,
  channel_dispense AS odsyp, channel_refill AS zasyp, channel_temperatures AS temperatury,
  CASE checked WHEN 1 THEN 'tak' ELSE 'nie' END AS sprawdzony, legacy_name AS "dawna nazwa", id,
  CAST(start * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST("end" * 1000 AS INTEGER) + 1000 AS to_ms
FROM period ORDER BY site, period_id
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT label AS okres, CASE time WHEN 'real' THEN 'rzeczywisty' WHEN 'estimated' THEN 'szacowany ±' || printf('%g', time_uncertainty_h) || ' h' ELSE 'zegar urządzenia' END AS czas,
  start AS od, "end" AS do, printf('%.1f h', ("end" - start) / 3600.0) AS długość,
  channel_dispense AS odsyp, channel_refill AS zasyp, channel_temperatures AS temperatury,

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, MIN(value) AS min, MAX(value) AS max
FROM weight, b
WHERE period = '${period}' AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)

FROM weight, b
WHERE period = '${period}' AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

targets.queryText:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT pin, timestamp, state FROM signal_changes WHERE period = '${period}' AND kind = 'surowy'
),
before AS (
  SELECT pin, state, MAX(timestamp) FROM s WHERE timestamp < (${__from} / 1000.0) GROUP BY pin
),
inside AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, pin, state FROM s WHERE timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
),
last AS (
  SELECT pin, state FROM (
    SELECT pin, state, MAX(time) FROM (SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside)
    GROUP BY pin
  )
)
SELECT time, 'pin ' || pin || COALESCE(' (' || (SELECT role FROM signal_events e WHERE e.period = '${period}' AND e.pin = u.pin LIMIT 1) || ')', '') AS metric, state AS value FROM (
  SELECT (${__from} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM before
  UNION ALL SELECT time, pin, state FROM inside
  UNION ALL SELECT (${__to} / 1000.0) AS time, pin, state FROM last
) u
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: Temperatury [°C] (średnia w przedziale, bez usuniętych odczytów)

targets.queryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, 'czujnik ' || sensor AS metric, AVG(value) AS value
FROM temperatures, b
WHERE period = '${period}' AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH b AS (SELECT MAX(1.0, $__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS s)
SELECT CAST(timestamp / b.s AS INTEGER) * b.s AS time, 'czujnik ' || sensor AS metric, AVG(value) AS value
FROM temperatures, b
WHERE period = '${period}' AND timestamp >= (${__from} / 1000.0) AND timestamp < (${__to} / 1000.0)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Zdarzenia w widocznym zakresie (klik w początek: przybliż ±30 s)

targets.queryText:
SELECT 'pin ' || pin || ' (' || role || ')' AS sygnał, start AS początek, "end" AS koniec, round(duration, 2) AS "czas [s]", pulse_count AS impulsy,
  CASE WHEN rejected = 1 THEN 'odrzucone' ELSE 'przyjęte' END AS status, CASE WHEN synthetic = 1 THEN 'tak' ELSE '' END AS ręczne,
  CAST((start - 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS from_ms, CAST(("end" + 30) * 1000 AS INTEGER) AS to_ms
FROM signal_events
WHERE period = '${period}' AND start < (${__to} / 1000.0) AND "end" >= (${__from} / 1000.0)
ORDER BY start
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT 'pin ' || pin || ' (' || role || ')' AS sygnał, start AS początek, "end" AS koniec, round(duration, 2) AS "czas [s]", pulse_count AS impulsy,

FROM signal_events
WHERE period = '${period}' AND start < (${__to} / 1000.0) AND "end" >= (${__from} / 1000.0)
